name: NOAA DisMAP West Coast annual bottom-trawl survey catch per unit effort

spatial.horizontal_crs: NAD83 Albers service geometry; record latitude/longitude fields used for browse-sector summaries

temporal.update_cadence: Monthly service and schema audit; human review before public aggregate replacement

evidence.supports: NOAA identifies the DisMAP survey catch-per-unit-effort product, CC0 rights and the current West Coast ArcGIS endpoint.
The original survey samples trawlable shelf and slope with standardized gear and is not a rocky-reef survey.
Direct layer inspection found 2023–2025 records and OBJECTID, SampleID, Year, Species, WTCPUE, Depth, Latitude and Longitude fields.

limitations: This is a derived NOAA distribution product from the NWFSC trawl survey, not an independent biological survey or a catch forecast.
Trawl gear misses untrawlable rocky reef and many shallower nearshore habitats. A zero is a survey noncatch for a selected taxon, not species absence.
The 2026-06-01 service layer label is a data-product version, not the date of fish observations; the audited records are from 2023–2025.
The service covers offshore and island waters. Approximate latitude browse-sector summaries do not establish jurisdiction, legal access, safe routes or an exact fishing ground.
Sample coordinates and fine-scale catch patterns are withheld from public target layers; records deeper than 200 ft are separately counted and cannot validate a 200 ft nearshore target.

producer.name: NOAA Fisheries Office of Science and Technology (DisMAP), using Northwest Fisheries Science Center survey data

provenance.access_service: NOAA DisMAP ArcGIS FeatureServer, derived from NWFSC West Coast Groundfish Bottom Trawl Survey
transformations: Filter exact years 2023–2025, California latitude/longitude bounds and named lingcod, Pacific halibut and rockfish taxa.
Paginate OBJECTID-ordered records and require source count, field schema, unique object IDs, valid depths and nonnegative WTCPUE.

Aggregate by approximate coastal latitude sector, year and target group; retain distinct sampled hauls, positive/zero hauls and a separate at-or-under-200-ft count, without publishing source coordinates.
